more_info.overview: Tetracyclines is the name of a family of antimicrobial compounds, including tetracycline and related derivatives. The members share a related chemical framework but are separately identified substances. This is a historical antibiotic entry, not the name of a conventional colour, preservative mixture or texture ingredient. The general identity source does not establish a current direct human-food application for the entire family.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
EU Regulation 1831/2003 ended feed-additive use of antibiotics other than coccidiostats and histomonostats from 1 January 2006; this rule concerns feed additives and does not itself prohibit authorised veterinary treatment.
